name: plan-phases-tool
body: The `apg_plan_phases` suite tool (`opencode-suite/tools/apg_plan_phases.ts`): it reports plan-phase health for one project — phases with no tasks, phases done but under review, `Gates` cycles, unsatisfied requirements, and requirements satisfied by more than one phase. Its top-level logic is a default-exported `tool({...})`; the one named function it declares is `detectCycle` (`ts.apg-opencode-suite.tools.apg_plan_phases.detectCycle`), whose behaviour is preserved. Its requirement findings must be scoped to the current project/branch rather than the global layers store.
